newsitem.title: USA: Triton to merge with Security Systems.
newsitem.headline: Triton to merge with Security Systems.

text.p: Triton Group Ltd said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to merge with Security Systems Holdings Inc, the Connecticut-based parent of Alarmguard Inc.

Triton said it plans to issue some 33 million common shares to SSH in connection with the merger. Triton shareholders will retain the 21.5 million shares and about 500,000 warrants already outstanding.
After the new shares are issued Triton's current shareholders will own 40 percent of the company while SSH shareholders will own 60 percent of the combined company.
The deal is subject to customary closing conditions and is expected to close by the end of the year.
Management of SSH will manage the combined entity.

Alarmguard is a security alarm service with residential and business subscribers, substantially all of which are located in the five eastern states of Connecticut, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Maryland.
